GetResolvedIdFn.name: GetResolvedIdFn
GetResolvedIdFn.doc:
Computes a node's Resolved ID from definitional facts. The ID must be unique
per menu root; it is the identity persistent state, registration, and
highlight key off.

Contract: the id may read the node's own facts (including its own sibling
`index`) and may walk `parent` for lineage (as the default definition-path
rule does), but it must not depend on an *ancestor's* sibling `index` —
reconciliation invalidates ids by def identity and definition path, not by
ancestor reordering, so ancestor-index-dependent ids would go stale. The
seam must also not mutate its argument.

PopupMenuNode.name: PopupMenuNode
PopupMenuNode.doc:
A menu node: the library-created, resolved instance of a node def.
Exactly one per logical row per menu root, in every render context —
object identity is Resolved ID identity, and `id` is its serialization.
Created by resolution at the root or by grafting; instances are stable
across content re-supplies (reconciliation swaps `def` in place).
The type parameter narrows `def`/`kind` for callers that know the def kind
statically. Narrowing is a lookup-time snapshot: reconcile may replace `def`
in place with another def of the same resolved id, so a long-held narrowed
reference sees the current def, not necessarily the exact object/type it was
looked up with.

props.description: Mirror of `def.kind`, stable for the node's lifetime.

This node's path component: explicit `def.id` verbatim when present,

their required `id`).

Definition Path: Definition Keys from the menu root to this node,
including its own key, root-first. Only submenu and subpage ancestors
contribute keys (groups, radio-groups, and tree-items are path-transparent).

props.description: Resolved ID selected by the root's identity policy.

props.name: depth
props.description: Def-tree depth counting every node kind; roots are 0.

props.name: index

The second parameter contains event details including the reason for the change.

UnresolvedMenuNode.name: UnresolvedMenuNode
UnresolvedMenuNode.doc:
A menu node before its resolved ID is assigned — the argument to `GetResolvedIdFn`.
Carries definitional facts only (`def`, `definitionKey`, `definitionPath`, resolved
`parent`, `depth`, def-tree sibling `index`). Contextual facts (search
state, deep-search flags, display position) are deliberately absent:
a context-dependent Resolved ID is inexpressible by construction.

props.name: index
props.description: Sibling index in the def tree (position within `parent.children`).

props.name: depth
props.description: Def-tree depth counting every node kind; roots are 0.

props.name: kind
props.description: Mirror of `def.kind`, stable for the node's lifetime.

props.name: def
props.formattedType:
| ItemDef
  | TreeItemDef
  | RadioItemDef
  | CheckboxItemDef
  | SubmenuDef
  | SubpageDef
  | SeparatorDef
  | GroupDef
  | RadioGroupDef
props.description: The originating def. Replaced in place when content is re-supplied.

props.name: definitionKey
props.description:
This node's path component: explicit `def.id` verbatim when present,
otherwise the slugified `value` (kinds without a display value use
their required `id`).

props.name: definitionPath
props.description:
Definition Path: Definition Keys from the menu root to this node,
including its own key, root-first. Only submenu and subpage ancestors
contribute keys (groups, radio-groups, and tree-items are path-transparent).

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the dropdown menu is open.
Use for controlled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Callback when the open state changes.
The second parameter contains event details including the reason for the change.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the dropdown menu is initially open.
Use for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Determines if the dropdown menu enters a modal state when open.

- `true`: user interaction is limited to the dropdown menu: document page scroll
  is locked, and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.
- `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.
- `'trap-focus'`: focus is trapped inside the dropdown menu, but document page
  scroll is not locked and pointer interactions outside of it remain enabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: virtualized
props.description:
Whether virtualization mode is enabled.
When true, items should provide an explicit `index` prop and
the `items` prop should be provided for navigation to work correctly.

props.name: items
props.description:
Pre-registered items for virtualization.
When provided with `virtualized={true}`, this allows navigation to work
for items that aren't currently mounted in the DOM.

props.name: onHighlightChange
props.description:
Callback when the highlighted item changes.
Useful for synchronizing with a virtualizer (e.g., scrollToIndex) or other UI state.
`id` is first. `node` is the resolved menu node carrying the highlighted ID, looked up in the menu's data-first tree — `null` when the highlight clears or when no data-first node carries that ID (e.g. JSX-defined rows). A JSX row that shares an ID with a data-first node yields that node; Resolved IDs are expected to be unique per menu.
The fourth parameter contains event details including the reason for the change.

props.name: closeOnOutsidePress
props.description:
When to close the menu on outside interactions (clicking outside or clicking the trigger when open).
- `'pointerdown'`: Close immediately when pointer is pressed outside (default)
- `'click'`: Close when a full click (pointerdown + pointerup) occurs outside

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description:
Event handler called after any open/close animations have completed.
When `clearSearchOnClose="after-exit"` is set on Surface, the search
will be cleared before this callback is invoked.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `close`: closes the menu imperatively.
- `unmount`: unmounts the popup imperatively (when keep-mounted mode is enabled).
- `setDisabled`: enables/disables the menu imperatively.

props.name: getResolvedId
props.description: Computes canonical Resolved IDs for data-first content from the Unresolved Menu Node (definitional facts only).
